title: State Registry Compliance Note - Registry Copies Among Outside Dose Entries on Immunization Services Courses
content:
Kestrel reports its own **Immunization Services** doses to the state immunization registry, and a copy of such a report can come back onto a course as a dose entry recorded from another provider. When a dose on a course is found not to count and the course's valid doses still needed are rebuilt from its dose history, registry copies are identified and taken off as follows.

### Compliance rule

> Registry copies are identified as follows. Where the dose history holds a dose entry recorded from another provider that is billed to a pharmacy benefit and Kestrel reported a dose of the course, each such entry is a registry copy of Kestrel's own report. Where it holds such an entry and Kestrel reported no dose of the course, every entry recorded from another provider is treated as unverified and set aside as a copy. Where it holds no such entry, no entry is a copy.

### Record terms

- **Recorded from another provider**: a dose entry on the course's history that names no Kestrel store.
- **Billed to a pharmacy benefit (plan-billed)**: the entry's payment route is the pharmacy benefit of an insurance plan, as opposed to cash, a medical benefit or a no-cost programme.
- **Kestrel reported a dose of the course**: the course carries at least 1 registry report entry; with 0 such entries Kestrel reported no dose of it.

### Identification matrix

| Plan-billed entry recorded from another provider on the course | Registry reports on the course | Entries taken off as copies |
|---|---|---|
| At least 1 | 1 or more | Each plan-billed entry recorded from another provider |
| At least 1 | 0 | Every entry recorded from another provider, plan-billed or not |
| None | any | None |

### Hypothetical dose histories

| History | Plan-billed outside entries | Other outside entries | Registry reports | Copies taken off |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| A | 1 | 1 cash-paid | 2 | 1 |
| B | 1 | 1 cash-paid | 0 | 2 |
| C | 0 | 2 cash-paid | 1 | 0 |
| D | 2 | 0 | 1 | 2 |

In history B no report of Kestrel's own stands behind the plan-billed entry, so both entries recorded from another provider are set aside as unverified copies. In history C there is no plan-billed entry from another provider, so no entry is a copy however many cash-paid outside entries the course holds.
